title: Real part of a nontrivial root of unity
statement:
Let $k \ge 2$ and write $\omega_k = e^{2\pi i / k}$ for the primitive $k$-th root of unity. For every nonzero $a \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$,
\[
\operatorname{Re}\!\left(\omega_k^{\,a}\right) \le \cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi}{k}\right),
\]
where $\omega_k^{\,a}$ denotes $\omega_k$ raised to the canonical representative of $a$ in $\{0, 1, \ldots, k-1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: a is a nonzero element of ℤ/kℤ
